conditions: The claim concerns base JSON as described in the December 2017 RFC 8259.
limitations: Earlier specifications could restrict a top-level JSON text to an object or array. The interoperable subset discussed in §2 does not exhaust RFC 8259's value production.
Host schema vocabularies and interpretations of individual object keys have separate rule sets.

triggers: Reassess a correction, changed edition, material contrary evidence, or a revised Language Index scope rule.

statement: RFC 8259 describes JSON as a text data interchange format. A JSON text serializes one value, which can be a primitive, an object, or an array.
